commands.checks: Registration note: the native build is the subject of this check. It uses only the runner's preinstalled bash and C++17 compiler (g++), installs no apt or pip packages and needs no Boost; it runs in about 7 s. This departs from the guide's dedicated-workflow rule for native builds, which maintainers can restore by moving the command to its own workflow. Runs the pinned verify.sh preamble, step-3 adapt.py command and step-4 block verbatim with BOOST_INCLUDE at the stand-in; requires the stand-in to be the compiled header, the 10 step-4 log lines and columns_k4.json to equal the committed Boost receipts, all 9 negative controls to be rejected by the checkers, an over-range stream to be refused, and a seeded differential test against Python integers with pinned in-range, near-bound and per-operation refusal coverage.
